prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering steps (moving sign-in), estimated countdown wait info, adding a pet control tutorial screen, and personality-driven copy helped performance.
Bypassing onboarding steps yielded mixed results, winning in one test but significantly hurting in another.
Major redesigns and sign-in safety hints significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout changes, permission checks, incentives, and most copy updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated actual gains, but underestimated performance for the pet control tutorial screen, countdown wait info, and personality-driven headlines.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +2.6% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +2.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -12.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, incentive: -1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.7%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.6%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.0%

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Interactive companion activity tips on waiting screen: Displays interactive tip slides on the waiting screen explaining desktop pet shortcut controls. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and users write support asking how to control or hide pets.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Desktop companion benefits story copy: Updates story copy to clarify how the pet sits quietly on the desktop without disturbing work. (why: Choose path drop-off is 21.3%; clarifying unobtrusive desktop pet behavior sets realistic expectations early.)
2: [adoption, incentive] Official pet adoption badge preview: Adds a collectible pet companion badge graphic to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption stage experiences significant drop-off (69.3% conversion); visual milestone rewards boost completion motivation.)
3: [finish, layout] Spotlight layout for final setup screen: Changes the home intro screen layout to spotlight mode focusing on the launch CTA button. (why: Finish conversion drops to 71.6% with long completion times (5815s mean); spotlight layout directs focus to final setup completion.)
4: [home, notification] Background desktop notification switch on wait screen: Enables readiness notifications and adds background task messaging on the generation waiting screen. (why: Generation wait mean duration is 2336s, causing users to abandon or assume the app stalled.)

scores.note: High evidence from support mail and wait duration; wait info and tutorials have proven effective.
Target step has 21.3% drop-off; copy updates at this step historically yield strong lift with low implementation cost.
Significant step drop-off, but incentive changes have shown no clear historical benefit.
High drop-off and duration, but layout modifications consistently show neutral or negative performance.
Funnel shows long wait times, but notification features have shown negligible impact in prior tests.
